metadata.question: In the summer of 2021, did at least 6 million hectares of forests burn in Sakha?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about forest fires in Sakha (which is in Russia) during summer 2021, specifically whether at least 6 million hectares burned. For this analysis, I need to: 1. Define Sakha region geometry (Yakutia/Sakha Republic in Russia) 2. Use burned area data - MODIS MCD64A1 collection is good for this 3. Time period: summer 2021 (June-August 2021) 4. Calculate total burned area in hectares 5. Compare to 6 million hectares threshold Data quality considerations: - Check if collection has data for the period - Check if there are valid burned pixels - Validate the calculated area makes sense The MCD64A1 collection provides burned area data with a BurnDate band that indicates when burning occurred. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const sakha = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Sakha')); const summer2021 = ['2021-06-01', '2021-08-31']; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Burned Area const burnedCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterBounds(sakha) .filterDate(summer2021[0], summer2021[1]); // Check collection size const colSize = burnedCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Summer 2021 burned area images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No burned area data found for summer 2021."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create burned area mask and calculate area const burnedArea = burnedCol.select('BurnDate').max(); // Create binary burned mask (BurnDate > 0 indicates burned) const burnedMask = burnedArea.gt(0); // Calculate pixel count and area const pixelStats = burnedMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().unweighted(), geometry: sakha, scale: 500, // MODIS resolution maxPixels: 1e10 }); const burnedPixels = pixelStats.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`Burned pixels: ${burnedPixels}`); if (burnedPixels === 0 || burnedPixels === null) { console.log("No burned pixels detected."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Convert to hectares (500m resolution = 25 hectares per pixel) const hectaresPerPixel = 0.25; // 500m × 500m = 0.25 hectares const totalBurnedHectares = burnedPixels * hectaresPerPixel; console.log(`Total burned area: ${totalBurnedHectares.toLocaleString()} hectares`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalBurnedHectares === null || totalBurnedHectares === undefined || !isFinite(totalBurnedHectares) || totalBurnedHectares < 0) { console.log("Invalid calculation result."); console.log("C3"); } else if (totalBurnedHectares >= 6000000) { console.log("Burned area meets/exceeds 6 million hectares."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Burned area less than 6 million hectares."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
